TAUNT.name: Taunt
TAUNT.describe: Single-target enemy attacks target it with a {{value}}% chance, and those hits deal half damage to it.

RIPOSTE.name: Riposte
RIPOSTE.describe: Counters every hit taken with {{value}}% of its attack.

EXECUTION.name: Execution
EXECUTION.describe: Up to +{{value}}% damage based on the target's missing HP.

VIGOR.name: Second Wind
VIGOR.describe: The first time its HP drops below 50% (even on a hit that would normally be fatal, which is then cancelled), it recovers {{value}}% of its max HP.

HASTE.name: Haste
HASTE.describe: Every {{value}} actions, it acts again immediately.

FORTIFY.name: Fortification
FORTIFY.describe: Each hit taken grants +{{value}}% DEF, stacking up to 5 times.

EMPOWER.name: Empowerment
EMPOWER.describe: Each attack landed grants +{{value}}% ATK, stacking up to 5 times.

BULWARK.name: Bulwark
BULWARK.describe: Starts the battle with a shield worth {{value}}% of its max HP.

CRIT.name: Precision
CRIT.describe: Every 2 attacks, deals a guaranteed critical hit whose critical damage is amplified by {{value}}%.

HAMPER.name: Shackle
HAMPER.describe: Each hit pushes the target's action gauge back by {{value}}%.

NEMESIS.name: Vengeance
NEMESIS.describe: +{{value}}% damage against enemies that hit an ally, doubled against those that took one down.

REGEN.name: Regeneration
REGEN.describe: Every 3 actions, heals {{value}}% of its max HP.

BLESSING.name: Blessing
BLESSING.describe: Every 3 actions, heals the weakest ally for {{value}}% of their max HP.

SANCTUARY.name: Sanctuary
SANCTUARY.describe: Every 3 actions, heals the whole team for {{value}}% of max HP.

BURN.name: Burn
BURN.describe: Inflicts a burn: {{value}}% of the hit's damage per turn for 2 turns.

POISON.name: Poison
POISON.describe: Poisons the target: {{value}}% of its max HP per turn for 2 turns.

MOMENTUM.name: Momentum
MOMENTUM.describe: After each action, advances the most delayed ally's action gauge by {{value}}%.

GUARDIAN.name: Bodyguard
GUARDIAN.describe: Redirects {{value}}% of the damage dealt to its allies onto itself, and takes only 40% of it.

HUNT.name: Hunter's Mark
HUNT.describe: Marks the target of its first hit: its team targets it with a {{value}}% chance and deals 15% more damage to it; when it falls, it acts again at once.

STUN.name: Stun
STUN.describe: Each hit has a {{value}}% chance to stun the target, which skips its next action.

WEAKEN.name: Weaken
WEAKEN.describe: Each hit lowers the target's ATK by {{value}}% for its next 2 actions.

SUNDER.name: Sunder
SUNDER.describe: Each hit leaves the target vulnerable: it takes {{value}}% more damage for its next 2 actions.
